fix_instructions: The dominant failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH. (1) For C5 (PF1): broaden the check to accept any commitment or decision that references a dispatch hold on V-17 pending steering/brake verification sign-off, regardless of whether the exact phrase 'dispatch hold control' appears. The model consistently encodes this as 'Dispatch hold remains in place until Motor Pool signs off the two-hour steering and brake verification' — align the check's matching pattern to that natural phrasing. (2) For C8 (PF4): relax the threshold so it passes on any commitment that mentions both a service-release inspection before handoff and the 1330 aircraft ground-service deadline, without requiring the full multi-clause phrasing that only rollout 0 happened to produce. The three failing rollouts all contain the substantive content but in more condensed form. (3) For C7 (PF3): ensure the check accepts commitments that reference 'communications-continuity check' and the 1200-1300 Signal Shop window even when the exact phrase 'power isolation and battery inspection' is abbreviated to 'Signal Shop controls 1200-1300,' as in rollout 3. Alternatively, instruct the settlement schema to require the full operational-control description for each asset so the model always includes all key terms.
